# Ecgberht — Face (campaign memory)

Plain-English campaign memory for cold-start. **Human narrative only.**
Typed instrument fields belong on the Strip — not on this Face.

---

## North star

Establish, honestly, whether RBS2418 is a **longevity asset** and not only an oncology asset — and if it is,
say so with numbers that hold up in front of people who will check them. Two claims are on trial. The first
is that inhibiting ENPP1 restores the immune surveillance that cold tumours switch off, so the drug could
stop cancers forming rather than only treat them once formed — which would raise global lifespan and
healthspan, and with it decades of lost productivity. The second is that the very same enzyme, through a
completely different substrate, drives the crystal arthritis that takes mobility away from the old — and
that mobility is what keeps people alive. One target, two diseases, both of them diseases of ageing. The
campaign is done when a sovereign investor and a sceptical clinician can both read the summary and find
nothing in it they can knock over.

---

## Active effort

- **Id / name:** L1 — settle the science before anything is modelled
- **Status:** IN_PROGRESS
- **One-line pointer:** the adversarial research run is commissioned and running; it has been told to try
  to break both theses rather than support them.

---

## Why next

Everything downstream is arithmetic on top of biology, so the biology has to be right first. Two of the
load-bearing claims are, at this moment, unverified — and one of them looks actively dangerous. The
arthritis story asks us to lower pyrophosphate in the joints, but pyrophosphate is what stops the body
calcifying its own arteries, and the people born without working ENPP1 suffer exactly that. Until that
tension is resolved we do not know whether the second thesis is a discovery or a liability. The other
claim — that about half of old-age arthritis comes from this pathway — is the multiplier that the entire
arthritis half of the model rests on, and it currently has no source behind it. Modelling first and
checking later would produce a confident number built on sand, and the room this goes into contains people
who will ask precisely these two questions.

---

## Human wait

- **Waiting on:** none — both open decisions were taken on 29 July. The run is scoped adversarially against
  both theses, and if the calcification window cannot be shown, the arthritis story is to be presented with
  the risk stated openly rather than quietly dropped.
- **Until / unblock:** n/a. The next human moment comes when the evidence returns and we learn whether
  either thesis survived.
